speaker: Kimi K3
text: HDFC Bank trades at roughly 11x forward earnings with a 21% earnings-growth forecast and a 3.8% dividend yield, so the 30% drop this year has pushed the valuation into a zone where long-term compounders usually start to outperform. The 1.08 beta means it will swing harder than the Nifty, but the 72% correlation says it still moves with the index — if the Bank Nifty stabilises above 54k, the risk-reward skews positive for a 12-18 month hold. On the cost side, a Rs 10,000 delivery trade on Zerodha costs 0.38% round-trip (Rs 38) plus 20% short-term capital-gains tax if you exit within a year; holding past 12 months drops the tax to 12.5% with the first Rs 1.25 lakh of gains exempt. For the US sleeve, fractional NVDA at $100 grows to only ~$125 at the recent 25% CAGR — 10x still needs either a multi-year runway or a much higher beta bet.
